claims.kickoff_quote: For each track in this wave, name the lane skill that owns its surface in the track's brief and have the implementer use it — ... payment-integration / fintech-engineer / mcp-developer for specialized domains. Pick from the plugins we actually enabled; a track with no matching lane just uses the core skills.
claims.skill_quote: description: "Use when the task involves fintech engineering — payment systems, banking integrations, trading platforms, KYC/AML, fraud detection, regulatory compliance, or compliance-heavy financial applications requiring secure transaction processing and transaction accuracy."
claims.reasoning: The only KICKOFF mention of fintech-engineer is a routing entry telling the orchestrator which lane skill to assign to which track, conditioned on which plugins were enabled at step 2. Assignment of a skill to a track, and the enablement gate, are facts the skill cannot know about itself; the skill's own description covers only when its content applies, not who dispatches it. Nothing of the skill's methodology, checklist, or reference chain is restated.
